title: What this proposal decides
subtitle: A grounded snapshot of the opportunity before the detailed slides
headline: Move invoice matching from line-by-line checking to a controlled three-way match that explains every exception.

highlights.title: Starting point
highlights.description: AP staff compare invoice, purchase-order and goods-receipt data by hand at month-end.

highlights.title: Recommended path
highlights.description: A deterministic match processes clean invoices and routes exceptions with a clear reason.

highlights.title: Human control
highlights.description: Approvals and unclear cases stay with people; the system never invents a match.

highlights.title: Ready to build
highlights.description: Chapter evidence is complete enough to plan the remaining slides and the first delivery steps.
